title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・盾の重さ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Between the sloped track and the 3,200-meter distance, Meisho Doto falls short against T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rest of the year will be just as long and difficult a journey as today, though. Doto desperately resolves to follow Opera O through to the end.
